title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for management of chronic conditions.

HPI
The patient presents today for a routine follow-up of type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease stage 4. The patient reports feeling stable overall and denies any new acute symptoms or concerns regarding their renal function. They report adherence to their current management plan. The patient's condition is managed through diet and exercise.

Medication List
No medications currently prescribed for diabetes.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Vital signs are within normal limits. Physical examination reveals no acute distress. Skin is intact, and no new lesions are noted.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus: Currently stable.
2. Chronic kidney disease stage 4: Stable for follow-up.

Plan
The patient will continue with their current management of type 2 diabetes, which remains diet controlled. We will continue to monitor renal function and laboratory values. The patient was instructed to maintain their current regimen of diet and exercise. Follow-up in three months.
explanations: CKD is listed under 'with' for diabetes in the Index, so the link is presumed: use the combination code E11.22.
Code also the CKD stage (N18.4) as instructed at the diabetes CKD code or separately when unrelated.

distractors.why: The provider does not have to write 'due to'; 'with' presumes the link.
E11.2 is a subcategory; a 5th character is required.
The stage of CKD must be reported with N18.-.
